AcademicRequirementsMetaData.subtitle: English Requirement
description: IELTS Academic: Minimum overall score of 6.0, with no band below 5.5
PTE Academic: Minimum overall score of 50, with no communicative skill below 42
TOEFL iBT (120 scale): Minimum overall score of 80, with a minimum Writing score of 21
TOEFL iBT (6-point scale): Minimum overall score of 4.0, with a minimum Writing score of 4.0
